description.value: Free Trait. You begin at the Fleshbound stage of the Decay ladder: zombie-like, pallid, rotting, slow. Undying Return and your poison/disease/corruption resistance are active. Faint stench and cold flesh are a light situational Stealth-by-smell / social flavor bane the Director may invoke, easily masked - no standing penalty. Your Decay stage advances with your character Tier, not with deaths (deaths are pure flavor toward the same destination): Tier 3 brings Withered/Skeletal (damage reduction), Tier 2 brings Spectral/incorporeality, Tier 1 brings full Spectral plus Grave-Cold Resilience.
